articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially launched GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a larger context window reaching 1M tokens. The model demonstrates measurable gains on graduate-level science benchmarks and complex multi-step coding tasks, narrowing the gap between LLM outputs and expert-level domain work.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini 2.5 Ultra Tops Agentic Coding and Research Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind released Gemini 2.5 Ultra, which achieves state-of-the-art results on SWE-Bench Verified and agentic research tasks, outperforming prior frontier models. The model integrates tighter tool-use loops and improved self-verification, making it particularly effective for autonomous multi-file code refactoring and scientific literature synthesis.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Assembly Lines
articles.summary: Tesla announced that its third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has started performing repetitive assembly and materials-handling tasks at two Gigafactory locations. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22-DOF hands and on-device vision-language models for real-time task adaptation, though Tesla cautions full autonomy in unstructured environments remains years away.

articles.title: Figure and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Pilot to Third Manufacturing Plant
articles.summary: Figure AI's partnership with BMW has scaled to a third Spartanburg-area facility, with Figure 02 robots now handling bin-picking, part inspection, and inter-station transport. The expansion follows positive ROI data from the initial pilot, with BMW reporting a measurable reduction in per-unit handling time and workplace ergonomic incidents.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude Tool-Use Chains for Enterprise Workflow Automation
articles.summary: Anthropic launched a new enterprise feature allowing Claude to orchestrate multi-step tool-use chains with human-in-the-loop checkpoints, targeting complex workflows in finance, legal, and software engineering. The system includes built-in audit trails and granular permission scoping, addressing a key compliance concern that has slowed agentic AI adoption in regulated industries.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 2nm A16 Process Node
articles.summary: TSMC confirmed volume production on its A16 2nm-class process using nanosheet gate-all-around transistors and backside power delivery. The node offers roughly 10-15% speed improvement and up to 30% power reduction over N3E, with Apple and NVIDIA among the first customers expected to tape out designs for 2027 consumer and data center products.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Approval to Expand Brain-Computer Interface Trial to 50 Patients
articles.summary: The FDA granted Neuralink approval to implant its N2 brain-computer interface device in up to 50 additional patients with severe paralysis, following positive 18-month safety and efficacy data from its initial cohort. Participants demonstrated sustained high-bandwidth cursor and robotic arm control, reigniting both clinical optimism and ethical debate around consumer neurotechnology timelines.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Demonstrates Autonomous Disaster-Site Navigation in DARPA Exercise
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics' electric Atlas humanoid completed a DARPA-organized urban search-and-rescue exercise, autonomously navigating rubble fields, opening doors, and locating simulated survivors using onboard LiDAR-vision fusion. The demonstration marks a significant step toward deployable general-purpose disaster-response robotics, though experts note the controlled environment still differs substantially from real collapse scenarios.
